|game_text=Deploy on table. [First Order] starships are deploy -1 (-2 to D'Qar) and hyperspeed +1. [Immune to Alter.]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Navy Of The First Order]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Navy Of The First Order (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-51046ae">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual25-Dark/large/navyofthefirstorder.gif</code> as published 7 August 2025: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/51046ae84b27bac1fd428fff5c477708c11c4fa2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/navyofthefirstorder.gif holotable commit 51046ae] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on table. [First Order] starships are deploy -1 (-2 to D'Qar) and hyperspeed +1. During your deploy phase, may reveal one [First Order] starship from hand to take a First Order pilot (or vice versa) into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) and deploy both simultaneously. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Navy Of The First Order (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 10 August 2025: “Deploy on table. [First Order] starships are deploy -1 (-2 to D'Qar) and hyperspeed +1. During your deploy phase, may reveal one [First Order] starship from hand to take a First Order pilot (or vice versa) into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) and deploy both simultaneously. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Navy Of The First Order]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Navy Of The First Order]] (published 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Navy Of The First Order”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
